chapter.title: OF OFFENCES RELATINGTO THE ARMY, [4][NAVY AND AIR FORCE]

heading: Deserter concealed on board merchant vessel through negligence of master.
text: The master or person in charge of a merchant vessel, on board of which any deserter from the Army, [9][Navy or Air Force] of the [10][Government of India] is concealed, shall, though ignorant of such concealment, be liable to a penalty not exceeding five hundred rupees, if he might have known of such concealment but for some neglect of his duty as such master or person in charge, or but for some want of discipline on board of the vessel.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
